name: Insert Marketplace
author: Stichting Insert

sections.description:
Effortlessly integrate your WordPress webshop with the Insert Marketplace and optimize your management of circular (construction) materials.
With this plugin, you can easily link your materials to our platform and streamline your sales process.
Benefit from a user-friendly interface, full control over your sales process, and reach a wide audience of architects, contractors, and construction professionals.
Promote the reuse of materials and contribute to a sustainable future.

Download the Insert Marketplace WP plugin today and start linking your webshop!

Note: A subscription is required for the integration. For more information, contact info@insert.nl
